capability.description: Portfolio-level aviation AI assurance screening with explicit ConOps and hazard-assessment limits

rationale: Precise trigger, ordered screen/framework/page-reference/technique steps; repeats that a portfolio screen is not a regulatory determination.
Explicit ConOps, hazard assessment, proposed Issue 03 and changing-guidance caveats support failure handling.
Specific hard-coded regulatory technique ceiling and EASA page references were NOT independently checked against current official EASA text; do not present as verified legal facts.

External Airside Labs MCP tool is required; host availability, data handling, provenance and current output schema not tested; business-sensitive use-case queries need separately scoped egress authority.
